question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a yellow present, Bob has a teal present, and Claire has a white present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) yellow present
(B) teal present
(C) white present
solution:
Present-color order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: yellow | teal | white
1. Alice and Claire swap: white | teal | yellow
2. Alice and Claire swap: yellow | teal | white
3. Claire and Alice swap: white | teal | yellow
Claire has the yellow present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
